items.evidence: lev-harness play --ticks 1: screen title, one JSON object with every key of the brief (tick..records).
play ... --frame f_stall.png --size 800x480 (also day, evening, morning): PNG header reads 800 x 480.
Fresh: texts Day Market, New season, Records, Stamps, Settings, Quit; menu_index 0; 0:up keeps 0; 8 downs stop at 4; enter on Quit ends run at tick 9 with state printed.

Settings texts Language: English / Difficulty: Normal / Season: 7 days; right->Spanish, stops; left back to English, stops; difficulty easy..hard stops both ends; season 7/3 stops; escape and Enter on Back go to title.
Run 1 on folder s1 set es/easy/3; run 2 on s1 starts es/easy/3. Fresh folders start en/normal/7, slots [null,null,null], stamps [], records [].

Spanish run: settings, slots, morning, stall, day, paused, evening, upgrades, title all Spanish (Ajustes, Ranura 1: Vacia, Puesto, En pausa, Tarde, Mejoras...); settings texts switch the same tick; es.json has every en key, only the game name equal. Records/stamps/season-over seen only through es.json strings.
assets/strings/en.json and es.json hold all strings; README 'Adding a language' explains copying en.json.
Fresh, enter on New season: texts New season, Slot 1: Empty, Slot 2: Empty, Slot 3: Empty; escape returns to title.
Enter on slot 1: morning, day 1, slot 1, coins 50, rep 50, empty stock, prices 4/6/11/14/7/9, upgrades [], crate_limit 8, order null, texts Morning, Day 1 of 7, Coins: 50.
Easy 3-day season: coins 60, Day 1 of 3, forecast 3 entries; Hard bankrupt runs started with 40 (36 spent, rent 30 -> -26); Continue after settings changed kept season_difficulty normal/length 7.
30 seeds: forecast 7 entries of sun/cloud/rain/heat, weather == forecast[0]; Weather: Heat / Rain / Sun texts follow; seed 1 gives the same forecast every run.
30 seeds x 6 goods all within base-1..base+2 (offsets -1,0,1,2 all seen); rows read like 'Apples: 3 a unit, stock 0'.
Apples at 3: coins 50->32, stock [{units 6, days_left 5}]; second lot -> 14, one batch of 12; row 'stock 12'. Bread days_left 1.
Cheese with 2 coins: coins and stock unchanged, 'Not enough coins' shown, gone after the next word (put). The 99-unit cap could not be reached with the coins available.
Day 1 order null; day 2 'Order: 8 Cheese for 132' (8*11*3/2); accept -> taken true, 'Order taken: 8 Cheese for 132'; second accept no change. Seed 28: 6 Apples for 36.
Later run on q1: title has Continue between New season and Records; Continue shows 'Slot 1: Day 1 of 7, 50 coins'.

Continue with --seed 7 on a slot saved by seed 1: morning day, coins, rep, stock, stall, prices, upgrades, forecast, wholesale, order equal to the unbroken game's; Enter on empty slot 2 left the slots screen unchanged.

Escape on Morning -> Paused [Paused, Resume, Title]; Resume and Escape return to same menu_index/state; Escape on Day -> paused with clock still; Title after buying apples: slot holds Day 1, 50 coins, Continue gives stock 0.
Stall: cursor (0,0), apples, texts Stall, Good: Apples, Price: 4, Stock: 12, Crates: 0 of 8.
down/left at (0,0) no move; up -> (0,1), up stops; 6 rights stop at x 5; down -> (5,0).
next_good x6: bread, cheese, fish, flowers, honey, apples with Good/Price/Stock texts following; prev_good from apples -> honey.
put at (5,0) -> stall [{5,0,apples}], Crates: 1 of 8; put again no change; take removes; take on empty no change; 9th put with 8 crates changed nothing.
Apples price_down 4->3->2->1->1; 12 x price_up -> 12 (cap); Price text follows.
Day 2 morning keeps day 1 stall (8 crates) and prices; Continue in a later run gives the same stall and prices.
Enter on Stall: screen day, clock 0, speed slow, texts 08:00, Speed: Slow, taken/served/walked_out/passed 0, visitors list filled.
Script check: ids 1..n, minutes increasing in 0..479, types valid, distinct wants 2/1/2/3; 30 seeds give 30 different lists; continued day gives the same list as unbroken.
--at each tick: slow +1 per 20 ticks, fast per 5, rush per tick, hold none (screen day); progress carried over slow->fast and rush->slow; texts 08:06, Speed: Slow.
finish at the day's first tick -> next state evening, clock 480, identical taken/served/walked_out/passed/sales/coins/rep/texts to the rush run.
Same day at slow (9700 ticks), fast, rush, and fast/hold/slow/rush/fast mix: evening results identical.
Per-minute check over a full rush day (34 visitors) and a Sign day: every visitor on the aisle at x = clock - m for m..m+5, off from m+6.
Per-minute check: without Sign empty-basket visitors take only front crates, back crate only with basket; only wanted, no duplicates.
Cook (v1, m 25) holds 2 apples at 4 at clock 25 with column 0, budget 40->32; apples at 5: only tourists buy; at 6: tourist buys; at 7: nobody.
Per-minute check: budget_left never negative/never exceeded; apples+bread held in aisle+queue never above stock (till baskets are not in the state).
Per-minute check: empty basket leaves at m+6 and passed counts them (26 = 34 - 8 buyers); with goods joins queue/till with joined m+6.

Seen: v1 at till from 31, ends 35, paid 20, coins/taken/served/rep up, sales entry; bargain pays tenth less in formula check. Not seen: units leaving the batch with fewest days_left (never had two batches of a good on sale).
Per-minute check: visitor leaving the aisle with free till is at the till that minute (ends = m+6+2+n); no till idle while queue nonempty.
No queued wait ever reached patience in my runs, but no walk-out ever happened, so the leaving effects (goods back, rep -2, walked_out +1) were not seen.
Seed 11, empty stall, last visitor at 475: evening passed 42 = visitors arriving by 473, walked_out 0; evening aisle/queue/tills empty.
Second till (80 coins) never affordable in my runs; not checked.
Seed 28 day 2 with Sign and apples only at back cell (0,1): empty-basket visitors took apples at x 0; per-minute check with sign 0 errors.
Taken 6 apples with 6 in stock: 'Order delivered: 36', coins +36, apples gone; taken with no stock: 'Order failed', rep 62->57; not taken: no line, no change.
Bread bought day 1 spoiled that evening ('Bread: sold 0, spoiled 6'); fish bought day 2 at 1 day left then spoiled day 3 evening (spoiled 6); honey never in a spoiled line.
Heat day apples 5 -> 3 without Cool box (two runs), 5 -> 4 with Cool box.
Rent: 36 Normal with 8 crates, 21 Easy with 3 crates, 15 Easy / 20 Normal / 30 Hard with none; taken from coins.
Evening: Evening, Day 1 of 7, Taken 84, Served 8, Walked out 0, Passed 26 (match state), per-good lines matching sales and stock, Rent, Coins, Reputation, Tomorrow: Sun (= forecast[1]).
Enter on Evening: Upgrades, Coins: 50, Next day, Second till: 80, Cool box: 40, Sign: 30, Extra crates: 50, Awning: 35; Next day -> Morning Day 2 of 7.

Cool box bought 50->10, upgrades [cool_box], row 'Cool box: owned', again no change; Second till with 50: Not enough coins, no change. Extra crates (crate_limit 12, 'of 12') never affordable; not checked.
Five bankrupt seasons: evening 'Bankrupt', slots empty, Season over with Bankrupt, Score: 0; records gain bankrupt true.
Easy 3-day season finished: Season over, Score: 84 (15+69), Days: 3, Best: 84; slot emptied; title without Continue.
After 6 ended seasons: 84 first, then 4 bankrupt 0s in order ended, 6th dropped; 'Score 84, 3 days, Easy', 'Score 0, 1 days, Hard, bankrupt'; later run shows the same.
Stamp lines on first earning only (day 2 sales showed no First coin line); stamps in stamp order; Stamps screen yes/no and same in a later run.
First coin on a day with a payment, not on days with none; Full stall with 8 crates, not with 3; Whole season on 3-day finished season.
Sold out earned when crated apples/bread ran out; not earned on a day where bread without a crate was emptied (by spoilage) and nothing was sold.
Day 2 played after Continue (other seed, later run) gives identical visitors, sales, evening texts as the unbroken game.
Same seed and script twice from fresh folders: identical full states; other seeds give other forecasts/wholesale/visitors.
Escape and Left on Evening, put and accept (day 1) on Morning, Enter on empty Continue slot: no change; Up at title top no change.
modules/work/data/rules.json holds goods, visitor types, hour rates, weather, upgrades, stamps; README 'Changing the data' covers good, type, upgrade, stamp.
f_stall.png: 6x2 grid, 8 crates in distinct colours at the state's cells (back row drawn on top), cursor outline at (3,1), panel Good: Apples, Price: 4, Crates: 8 of 8.
f_day.png at clock 143: crates, aisle with tourists (green) at x 1 and 4 and cook (white, with basket mark) at x 3 as in state, till box, panel time, Speed, Coins, Taken, Served, Reputation.
Only the Morning frame was looked at (texts shown, chosen row in bold); title, slots, settings, upgrades, paused, evening and season-over frames not viewed.
README gives keys, kept files under --settings, and play/frame commands that ran as written.

defects: Enter on a Language/Difficulty/Season row of Settings also changes that setting (README admits it); the brief gives Enter no meaning there.
An input at the run's last tick is refused by the play command ('would never be given'), while the brief says a word at tick T acts after T ticks.
The setting values in the state show a Left/Right change on the tick of the word while menu_index and length follow a tick later (inconsistent timing inside one state).
could_not_check: d14: the 99-unit stock cap needs about 100 coins of one good; never reached.
d35: taking units from the batch with fewest days_left needs two batches of a good being sold; not set up.
d37: no visitor ever walked out of the queue in my runs.
d39: Second till never affordable in my runs.
d60: not every screen's frame was viewed, within the judge's token budget.
